sources.name: UVH-26
sources.size_reported: 26,646 high-resolution 1920x1080 images; source PNG payload is 89,844,752,340 bytes (89.84 GB / 83.67 GiB); 80/20 publisher train/validation; 14 vehicle categories
sources.annotations: COCO JSON, both Majority Voting and STAPLE variants
sources.download_note: Images are multi-megabyte each; fetching the complete corpus requires many tens of gigabytes. Application startup does not download it; the revision-pinned downloader requires explicit license acknowledgement.

sources.name: ACCIDENT: A Benchmark Dataset for Vehicle Accident Detection from Traffic Surveillance Videos
sources.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (current Kaggle dataset metadata; non-commercial and share-alike restrictions)
sources.size_reported: 20,158,641,093 bytes archive; 2,027 real surveillance clips and 2,211 CARLA synthetic clips according to source metadata
sources.annotations: Collision types, temporal accident point, spatial accident location; synthetic subset additionally documents boxes, masks, and tracklets
sources.download_authentication: Kaggle CLI login required for picekl/accident
sources.download_note: Dataset archive is not bundled. Kaggle CLI credentials are absent locally. Do not use for commercial NexSafe deployments without separate written permission; attached/downloaded media must remain within the applicable license.

sources.name: TU-DAT
sources.license: Paper is CC BY 4.0; dataset/media-specific reuse terms were not independently verified
